paragraphs.en: Industry officials cite two reasons for the influx: Chinese models' price competitiveness, backed by heavy state subsidies, and the absence of effective domestic policy tools to answer them. The Center for Strategic and International Studies has estimated that Beijing provided $230.9 billion in support to its EV industry between 2009 and 2023. China's auto production capacity grew by about 10.21 million units between 2020 and 2025, to roughly 29.67 million, while domestic sales rose only about 4.45 million, to 23.74 million. Manufacturers have therefore redirected surplus output overseas at low prices, and Benchmark Mineral Intelligence found that domestic EV sales in China fell 12 percent in October.
paragraphs.ko: 업계 관계자들은 유입의 이유로 정부의 막대한 보조금에 힘입은 중국 모델의 가격 경쟁력, 그리고 이에 맞설 국내 정책 수단의 부재를 꼽아요. 전략국제문제연구소(CSIS)는 중국 정부가 2009년부터 2023년까지 자국 전기차 산업에 2309억 달러를 지원했다고 추산해요. 중국의 자동차 생산능력은 2020~2025년 약 1021만 대 늘어 약 2967만 대가 됐지만, 내수 판매는 약 445만 대 늘어 2374만 대에 그쳤어요. 그래서 제조사들이 남는 물량을 싼값에 해외로 돌렸고, 벤치마크 미네랄 인텔리전스는 중국 내수 전기차 판매가 10월에 12% 줄었다고 밝혔어요.

sents.en: Industry officials cite two reasons for the influx: Chinese models' price competitiveness, backed by heavy state subsidies, and the absence of effective domestic policy tools to answer them.
sents.ko: 업계 관계자들은 유입의 이유로 정부의 막대한 보조금에 힘입은 중국 모델의 가격 경쟁력, 그리고 이에 맞설 국내 정책 수단의 부재를 꼽아요.

sents.en: The Center for Strategic and International Studies has estimated that Beijing provided $230.9 billion in support to its EV industry between 2009 and 2023.
sents.ko: 전략국제문제연구소(CSIS)는 중국 정부가 2009년부터 2023년까지 자국 전기차 산업에 2309억 달러를 지원했다고 추산해요.

sents.en: China's auto production capacity grew by about 10.21 million units between 2020 and 2025, to roughly 29.67 million, while domestic sales rose only about 4.45 million, to 23.74 million.
sents.ko: 중국의 자동차 생산능력은 2020~2025년 약 1021만 대 늘어 약 2967만 대가 됐지만, 내수 판매는 약 445만 대 늘어 2374만 대에 그쳤어요.

sents.en: Manufacturers have therefore redirected surplus output overseas at low prices, and Benchmark Mineral Intelligence found that domestic EV sales in China fell 12 percent in October.
sents.ko: 그래서 제조사들이 남는 물량을 싼값에 해외로 돌렸고, 벤치마크 미네랄 인텔리전스는 중국 내수 전기차 판매가 10월에 12% 줄었다고 밝혔어요.

paragraphs.en: Domestic carmakers' share of the overall EV market fell from 75 percent in 2022 to 55 percent over the first nine months of this year, the manufacturers' association said. Among passenger EVs alone, their share dropped to 48.7 percent, below a majority, while 112,417 Chinese-made EVs were newly registered, equal to 43.5 percent of the market. At last month's national audit, lawmakers from both the ruling and opposition parties agreed that EVs should be added to the domestic production tax credit. The government's tax reform plan introduced the credit this year but left electric vehicles out, and 24 amendment bills have been filed since the current National Assembly convened. People Power Party lawmaker Ahn Sang-hun raised the issue on Oct. 22, urging that EVs be eligible regardless of whether companies have invested in new facilities.
paragraphs.ko: 국내 완성차 업체의 전체 전기차 시장 점유율은 2022년 75%에서 올해 1~9월 55%로 떨어졌다고 자동차산업협회가 밝혔어요. 승용 전기차만 보면 점유율이 과반 아래인 48.7%로 내려갔고, 같은 기간 중국산 전기차 11만 2417대가 새로 등록돼 시장의 43.5%를 차지했어요. 지난달 국정감사에서 여야 의원들은 전기차를 국내 생산 세액공제 대상에 넣어야 한다는 데 뜻을 모았어요. 정부 세제 개편안이 올해 이 공제를 도입하면서 전기차는 뺐고, 현 국회가 열린 뒤 전기차를 넣자는 개정안이 24건 발의됐어요. 국민의힘 안상훈 의원이 10월 22일 이 문제를 제기하며 기업이 새 설비에 투자했는지와 상관없이 전기차를 대상에 넣자고 촉구했어요.

paragraphs.en: Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Lee Hyeong-il said on Nov. 2, at an industry roundtable in Hwaseong, that the government would engage actively in the Assembly's deliberations on an EV credit. The National Assembly's tax subcommittee is expected to take up the amendments this month, and whether to include EVs and how widely to define the credit will be the key issues. The Korea Automobile Manufacturers Association says the auto industry made up 14.1 percent of domestic manufacturing output in 2024 and supports about 1.56 million direct and indirect jobs. Association president Jeong Dae-jin argued that a credit for EV production would not benefit only automakers but would also strengthen the domestic production base, helping consumers and parts suppliers. One industry official warned that Chinese EVs are absorbing a large share of rising domestic demand, which keeps the growing home market from translating into more domestic production.
paragraphs.ko: 이형일 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관은 11월 2일 화성에서 열린 업계 간담회에서 정부가 전기차 세액공제를 논의하는 국회 심의에 적극 참여하겠다고 말했어요. 국회 조세소위가 이달 개정안을 다룰 것으로 보이며, 전기차를 포함할지와 공제 범위를 얼마나 넓힐지가 핵심 쟁점이에요. 한국자동차모빌리티산업협회에 따르면 자동차 산업은 2024년 국내 제조업 생산의 14.1%를 차지하고 직간접 일자리 약 156만 개를 떠받쳐요. 정대진 협회장은 전기차 생산 세액공제가 완성차 업체만 이롭게 하는 것이 아니라 국내 생산 기반을 강화해 소비자와 부품업체도 돕는다고 주장했어요. 한 업계 관계자는 중국산 전기차가 커지는 내수 수요의 상당 부분을 빨아들여 커진 국내 시장이 국내 생산 증가로 이어지지 못한다고 우려했어요.

views.view: Attributes the record gap largely to strong sales of Tesla EVs built at its Shanghai Gigafactory, with BYD and Polestar also selling China-made cars.
Reports that Tesla topped imported car sales for a ninth month, with its China-made models priced competitively, though October sales fell on supply shortages.
Frames the flood of subsidized Chinese EVs as a threat to Korean automakers and reports bipartisan calls to add EVs to the production tax credit.
Notes domestic carmakers' passenger EV share has fallen below a majority and that an industry official wants support for core strategic industries.

heads.title: S. Korea's car trade deficit with China hits record on Tesla EV imports
Tesla imports push Korea’s car trade deficit with China to record high
China-made Teslas drive Korea's auto trade deficit with China to record high
Chinese-made cars take 34% of S.Korea's EV market, driving record auto trade deficit

why: Cars are among Korea's biggest exports, and a record shortfall with China shows how quickly Chinese-built EVs are reshaping the home market.
lines.agree: Everyone agrees that Chinese-built EVs, especially Tesla's Shanghai-made models, are driving the widening deficit.
lines.split: Lawmakers and industry want a tax credit for domestic EV production, while Tesla's China-made cars are counted as imports from China.
lines.life: Students shopping for an EV may find China-made models cheaper, but a growing share of Korea's EV market now comes from abroad.
lines.next: Watch whether the tax subcommittee adds EVs to the domestic production tax credit this month.

talk.q: What does Korea's record car trade deficit with China tell you about the future of its auto industry?

talk.answer: I think it shows that Chinese-built EVs, including Tesla's Shanghai models, are winning on price. Domestic carmakers' share of the passenger EV market has already fallen below half. Korea needs support for domestic EV production, but it should also keep improving quality so consumers choose local brands.

paragraphs.en: The FBI is investigating an apparent breach of the National Crime Information Center, a central criminal-records database, according to US media reports that cited two people briefed on the matter. CNN and The Associated Press both reported the apparent hack, and a law enforcement source later confirmed to ABC News that the database had been breached. Who carried out the intrusion and how much data was reached remained unclear, and the bureau did not respond to a request for comment from the BBC.
paragraphs.ko: FBI가 이 문제를 보고받은 두 사람을 인용한 미국 언론 보도에 따르면, 핵심 범죄 기록 데이터베이스인 전국범죄정보센터가 해킹당한 것으로 보이는 사건을 조사하고 있어요. CNN과 AP 통신이 모두 해킹 정황을 보도했고, 이후 한 법 집행 관계자가 ABC 뉴스에 데이터베이스가 뚫린 것이 맞다고 확인해 줬어요. 침입을 누가 했는지, 데이터가 얼마나 노출됐는지는 아직 분명하지 않고, FBI는 BBC의 논평 요청에 답하지 않았어요.

sents.en: CNN and The Associated Press both reported the apparent hack, and a law enforcement source later confirmed to ABC News that the database had been breached.

paragraphs.en: The database, known as NCIC, is the system that federal, state and local police use to share information on warrants, background checks and similar matters. According to the FBI, it holds criminal record histories along with data on current fugitives, stolen property and missing persons, making it a key tool for officers nationwide. Jason Pack, a retired FBI agent, told ABC News that everyone from a rural Tennessee deputy to a federal investigator uses it to check wanted persons and stolen vehicles. Pack noted that the FBI maintains the system but that it is linked to law enforcement agencies nationwide, which matters when investigators ask how an intruder got in.
paragraphs.ko: NCIC로 알려진 이 데이터베이스는 연방, 주, 지방 경찰이 체포 영장, 신원 조회 같은 정보를 공유하는 데 쓰는 시스템이에요. FBI에 따르면 이 시스템에는 범죄 기록 이력과 함께 현재 수배 중인 도주범, 도난품, 실종자 자료가 담겨 있어서 전국 경찰관이 매일 쓰는 도구예요. 은퇴한 FBI 요원 제이슨 팩은 ABC 뉴스에, 테네시 시골 부보안관부터 연방 수사관까지 모두 수배자와 도난 차량을 확인할 때 이 시스템을 쓴다고 말했어요. 팩은 FBI가 시스템을 관리하지만 전국의 법 집행 기관이 여기에 연결돼 있고, 수사관이 침입자가 어떻게 들어왔는지 따질 때 이 점이 중요하다고 짚었어요.

paragraphs.en: President Donald Trump addressed the reports in a Saturday phone interview with Fox News, saying he had just heard about the hack and that it was not good. "I don't like that," he said, before adding that maybe people would learn things they would never have learned otherwise. He tied that idea to what he calls the Russia hoax, implying without offering evidence that the hack might touch investigations into Russian interference in the 2016 election. He also alluded to the phone call with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy that led to his first impeachment by Congress, according to ABC News. ABC News pointed out that the NCIC would not contain information about those investigations, and said the White House had not immediately commented on the incident.

ABC 뉴스에 따르면 그는 의회가 첫 탄핵에 나서게 된 계기였던 볼로디미르 젤렌스키 우크라이나 대통령과의 통화도 거론했어요. ABC 뉴스는 NCIC에 그런 수사에 관한 정보는 들어 있지 않다고 짚었고, 백악관은 이 사건에 대해 곧바로 입장을 내지 않았다고 전했어요.

sents.en: President Donald Trump addressed the reports in a Saturday phone interview with Fox News, saying he had just heard about the hack and that it was not good.

sents.en: "I don't like that," he said, before adding that maybe people would learn things they would never have learned otherwise.

sents.en: He tied that idea to what he calls the Russia hoax, implying without offering evidence that the hack might touch investigations into Russian interference in the 2016 election.

paragraphs.en: A former FBI official told CNN the concern was not only whether hackers reached sensitive data but also whether they could undermine the accuracy of records that officers rely on. Pack said he expected the bureau to put its best cyber investigators on the case and stressed that officers must trust the information returned when they run a name. Such details, he said, can sometimes mean the difference between an officer going home safely at the end of a shift and not. Dan Lorhmann, a former National Security Agency analyst, told the BBC that NCIC data includes critical information about criminal activity nationwide and must be protected. He said the level of cyber-attacks is rising globally for many reasons, but that he still has faith in government experts and in their ability to keep such data safe.
paragraphs.ko: 전직 FBI 관계자는 CNN에, 우려되는 것은 해커가 민감한 자료에 접근했는지만이 아니라 경찰관이 의존하는 기록의 정확성을 흔들 수 있는지도 된다고 말했어요. 팩은 FBI가 최고의 사이버 수사관들을 이 사건에 투입할 것으로 본다며, 경찰관이 이름을 조회했을 때 돌아오는 정보를 믿을 수 있어야 한다고 강조했어요. 그는 그런 정보가 때로는 경찰관이 근무를 마치고 무사히 귀가하느냐 아니냐를 가를 수도 있다고 말했어요. 전직 미국 국가안보국 분석가 댄 로어만은 BBC에, NCIC 자료에는 전국의 범죄 활동에 관한 핵심 정보가 들어 있어 반드시 보호해야 한다고 말했어요. 그는 여러 이유로 전 세계에서 사이버 공격 수준이 높아지고 있지만, 자신은 정부 전문가들과 그런 자료를 안전하게 지킬 이들의 능력을 여전히 믿는다고 말했어요.

paragraphs.en: It is not the first time hackers have targeted the bureau, which in September said it was investigating a breach claimed by the cyber-crime group ShinyHunters. The group claimed to have stolen sensitive data on all of the bureau's roughly 38,000 staff, and a former agent told the BBC he feared for current employees' safety. Separately, NBC News reported a cyberattack on the US Department of Agriculture, saying employees were informed on Thursday that its farm payment system had been targeted. The department has not publicly commented, and it remained unclear whether the two incidents were related or who was responsible.
paragraphs.ko: 해커가 FBI를 노린 것은 이번이 처음이 아니에요. FBI는 지난 9월 사이버 범죄 조직 샤이니헌터스가 주장한 침해 사건을 조사하고 있다고 밝혔어요. 이 조직은 FBI 직원 약 3만 8천 명 전원의 민감한 자료를 훔쳤다고 주장했고, 한 전직 요원은 BBC에 현직 직원들의 안전이 걱정된다고 말했어요. 별도로 NBC 뉴스는 미국 농무부에 대한 사이버 공격을 보도하며, 직원들이 목요일에 농무부의 농가 지급 시스템이 공격 대상이 됐다는 통보를 받았다고 전했어요. 농무부는 공개적으로 입장을 내지 않았고, 두 사건이 서로 관련이 있는지 누구 소행인지는 분명하지 않아요.

paragraphs.en: The Japan Times said the incidents were first reported on Friday by NBC News and CNN and that worries over the security of American computer systems were growing. The reports follow last week's tech outages in banking, air traffic control and other sectors, which officials say were not cyber-attacks but which lawmakers are scrutinizing. The BBC also noted that White House National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross was fired this week, with Trump saying he was not good enough.

issues.gist: The FBI is investigating an apparent hack of the National Crime Information Center, the database police nationwide use to share warrants and background checks. President Donald Trump called the reported breach "not good," while the perpetrators and scale remain unclear.
issues.gistKo: FBI가 전국 경찰이 영장과 신원 조회 정보를 공유하는 전국범죄정보센터 데이터베이스의 해킹 정황을 조사하고 있어요. 트럼프 대통령은 이 보도를 '좋지 않다'고 말했지만 범인과 피해 규모는 아직 분명하지 않아요.
issues.easyKo: 경찰이 전국에서 함께 쓰는 범죄 정보 데이터베이스가 해킹당한 것으로 보여 FBI가 조사하고 있어요. 누가 했는지, 얼마나 뚫렸는지는 아직 몰라요.

views.view: The BBC reported the apparent breach and noted it follows a September FBI hack and a string of US tech outages.
TechCrunch said the scope of the breach was unclear and relayed a former official's worry about the accuracy of records.
ABC News confirmed the hack through a law enforcement source and noted the NCIC holds no data on the Russia probes Trump mentioned.
The Japan Times said the FBI and USDA incidents deepened concerns about the security of US computer systems.

FBI's national crime database targeted in hack, Trump says

why: The NCIC is the shared backbone police across the country use to check warrants and wanted persons.
A breach could expose data or even undermine the accuracy of records that officers rely on.
lines.agree: Sources agree the FBI is investigating an apparent hack and that the perpetrators and scale are still unknown.
lines.life: Students could take this as a reminder that even trusted public databases need strong cyber defenses.
lines.next: Watch for who is blamed, how much data was reached and whether the FBI and USDA incidents prove linked.

talk.q: Why does the accuracy of a police database matter as much as keeping it secret?

talk.answer: Officers run names through the system to find wanted persons and stolen vehicles, so wrong data could put them in danger. A former FBI official worried hackers might undermine the accuracy of records. I think public agencies should protect the integrity of data as seriously as its secrecy.

issues.title: BBC Apologises After Sex Noises Played During Live Strictly Show in Blackpool as Police Look Into Incident
issues.titleKo: 블랙풀에서 열린 「스트릭틀리」 생방송 도중 성적인 소리가 재생되자 BBC가 사과하고 경찰이 조사에 나서요
issues.gist: The BBC has apologised after lewd audio was played from the audience during Saturday's live Strictly Come Dancing show in Blackpool. Lancashire police have seized a phone and are assessing whether any criminal offences took place.
issues.gistKo: 토요일 블랙풀에서 생방송된 「스트릭틀리 컴 댄싱」 도중 객석에서 음란한 소리가 재생되자 BBC가 사과했어요. 랭커셔 경찰은 휴대전화를 압수하고 범죄 혐의가 있는지 살피고 있어요.
issues.easyKo: 인기 댄스 경연 프로그램 생방송 중에 누군가 이상한 소리를 틀어서 방송이 방해받았어요. BBC는 사과했고 경찰은 휴대전화를 압수해 조사하고 있어요.

paragraphs.en: The BBC has apologised after a recording of sex noises was played during Saturday's live Strictly Come Dancing show from Blackpool's Tower Ballroom, prompting a police inquiry. The audio appeared to come from the audience just as judge Motsi Mabuse was giving feedback on the dance of Delta Goodrem and her partner Kai Widdrington. Microphones picked up the noise, and Mabuse paused, turned towards the audience to work out what was happening, then faced the camera again and quipped: "It's not me." At the close of the programme, presenter Emma Willis told viewers the BBC wished to apologise if they had heard any audio disruptions earlier in the show and for any offence caused.

paragraphs.en: Lancashire Constabulary said it was aware of an incident during filming in Blackpool, had been in contact with the event organisers and had received a formal complaint. A mobile phone has been seized, the force said, and officers are now assessing whether any criminal offences may have been committed. Content creator Daniel Jarvis, whose videos include pranks, streamed the moment on social media and appeared to place a phone call shortly before the audio began playing in the ballroom. He suggested that he was trying to target judge Craig Revel Horwood over what he called the judge's "bullying", according to the BBC's account of the stream.
paragraphs.ko: 랭커셔 경찰은 블랙풀 촬영 중 사건을 알고 있으며 행사 주최 측과 연락했고 공식 고소 · 신고를 받았다고 밝혔어요. 경찰은 휴대전화 한 대를 압수했으며 형사상 범죄가 있었는지 따져 보고 있다고 말했어요. 장난 영상을 올리는 콘텐츠 제작자 대니얼 재비스가 그 순간을 소셜 미디어로 생중계했고, 볼룸에서 소리가 나기 직전 전화를 거는 것처럼 보였어요. BBC가 전한 생중계 내용에 따르면 그는 심사위원 크레이그 레벨 호우드의 이른바 「괴롭힘」을 겨냥하려 했다고 시사했어요.

paragraphs.en: Jarvis has previously claimed responsibility for sex noises that disrupted the BBC's Match of the Day programme in 2023, the BBC noted. Deadline recalled that live coverage of an FA Cup replay between Wolves and Liverpool was disrupted by a similar apparent pornography prank in 2023. Gary Lineker, anchoring the build-up at the time, joked to fellow presenter Alan Shearer that he did not know who was making the noise. Lineker later tweeted a picture of a phone that he said had been taped to the back of the set in an apparent act of sabotage.

views.view: The BBC apologised for any offence caused and said it was investigating how the disruption happened during the live broadcast.
Deadline set the incident beside a similar 2023 prank on BBC football coverage, calling it the second time a BBC live show was interrupted this way.

heads.title: BBC apologises for 'any offence caused' by Strictly noise disruption
BBC Apologizes After ‘Strictly Come Dancing’ Is Interrupted By Sex Noises

why: A prank broke into a prime-time BBC live show, raising questions about audience security and the corporation's duty to its viewers.
Police are now assessing whether any criminal offences took place.
lines.agree: The BBC, police and press accounts agree that lewd audio was played in the ballroom during the live show and that a phone was seized.
lines.life: Live events can be disrupted by a single phone and a prank, so organisers weigh open audiences against control over what reaches the broadcast.
lines.next: Watch whether Lancashire police find that any criminal offences were committed and what the BBC's own inquiry concludes.

talk.q: How should broadcasters protect live shows from pranks without shutting out their audiences?
talk.qKo: 방송사는 관객을 막지 않으면서 생방송을 장난으로부터 어떻게 지킬 수 있을까요?
talk.answer: Broadcasters could tighten checks on phones and equipment near the set while still welcoming a live audience. In this case a phone was seized and police are looking into it, which shows that one device can disrupt a whole show. I think clear rules for the audience are better than closing the doors.
talk.answerKo: 방송사는 관객을 계속 받아들이면서도 세트 가까이의 휴대전화와 장비 점검을 강화할 수 있어요. 이번에는 휴대전화 한 대가 압수되어 경찰이 조사 중인데, 기기 하나가 쇼 전체를 방해할 수 있다는 걸 보여 줘요. 문을 닫기보다 관객을 위한 분명한 규칙이 낫다고 생각해요.

issues.title: Host South Korea Wins Men's Relay Gold as Shin Dong-min Doubles Up at Seoul Short Track World Tour
issues.titleKo: 개최국 한국이 서울 쇼트트랙 월드투어 남자 계주에서 금메달을 땄고 신동민은 2관왕에 올랐어요
issues.gist: South Korea won the men's 5,000-meter relay on the final day of the ISU Short Track World Tour in Seoul, edging the Netherlands and Canada, as Shin Dong-min added a second gold. Choi Min-jeong, in her announced final season, took the 1,000 meters on Saturday and finished fourth in two Sunday finals.
issues.gistKo: 한국이 서울 ISU 쇼트트랙 월드투어 마지막 날 남자 5000m 계주에서 네덜란드와 캐나다를 제치고 우승했고, 신동민은 금메달 두 개를 땄어요. 은퇴를 예고한 시즌의 최민정은 토요일 1000m에서 우승했고 일요일 결승 두 곳에서는 4위를 했어요.
issues.easyKo: 서울 목동에서 열린 쇼트트랙 월드투어에서 한국 남자 계주팀이 마지막 날 금메달을 땄어요. 신동민은 금메달 두 개를 따냈고, 최민정은 1000m 3연속 우승을 했어요. 계주 마지막 주자 림종운은 도핑 규정 위반 논란 속에서 출전했어요.

paragraphs.en: South Korea won the men's 5,000-meter relay on the final day of the International Skating Union Short Track World Tour in Seoul on Sunday, finishing ahead of the Netherlands and Canada at Mokdong Ice Rink. The winning quartet of Shin Dong-min, Kim Tae-sung, Lee Jeong-min and Rim Jong-un held off a strong Dutch challenge in a tight finish at the rink in western Seoul. It was the only gold South Korea collected on Sunday, and Shin, who had claimed the 1,500 meters a day earlier, finished the competition with two gold medals.
paragraphs.ko: 한국이 일요일 서울에서 열린 국제빙상경기연맹(ISU) 쇼트트랙 월드투어 마지막 날, 목동 아이스링크에서 열린 남자 5000m 계주에서 네덜란드와 캐나다를 제치고 우승했어요. 신동민, 김태성, 이정민, 림종운으로 이뤄진 우승 팀은 서울 서쪽 링크에서 네덜란드의 거센 추격을 막아내며 접전 끝에 결승선을 통과했어요. 이날 한국이 딴 금메달은 이것 하나뿐이었고, 전날 1500m에서 우승한 신동민은 이번 대회를 금메달 두 개로 마쳤어요.

paragraphs.en: South Korea hung back early in the 45-lap final while the Netherlands, Italy and Canada set the pace at the front of the pack. Lee Jeong-min lifted the hosts into third place with 23 laps remaining, turning the race into a three-way battle with the Dutch and the Italians. Lee then moved South Korea up to second with 17 laps to go, even as the Netherlands clung to the lead and refused to give ground. Shin surged to the front with 10 laps left, and the two teams then ran neck and neck through the closing stretch of the race. Rim, skating the anchor leg for South Korea, applied the finishing touch with a frantic dash across the line to edge the Dutch and secure the title.

paragraphs.en: Rim competed in Seoul under the cloud of a possible suspension for breaching anti-doping rules, a matter that was revealed in August. According to Yonhap, he had failed three times over the previous 12 months to supply the International Testing Agency with information on his whereabouts. A combination of three missed tests or filing failures within any 12-month period can bring a maximum ban of two years from competition. Rim has argued his case through an attorney and has so far been permitted to continue racing on the World Tour while the matter is unresolved. "When I am on the ice, I only think about the race at hand and put aside all the other distractions," Rim said after the final. He added that the medal carried special meaning because the four skaters had won it together as a team.
paragraphs.ko: 림종운은 8월에 알려진 도핑 방지 규정 위반으로 인한 출전 정지 가능성이라는 그늘 속에서 서울 대회를 치렀어요. 연합뉴스에 따르면 그는 지난 12개월 동안 세 차례 국제검사기구(ITA)에 자신의 소재지 정보를 제출하지 못했어요. 12개월 안에 검사 불응이나 소재지 정보 제출 실패가 합쳐서 세 번 쌓이면 최대 2년의 출전 정지를 받을 수 있어요. 림종운은 변호인을 통해 소명하고 있고, 문제가 해결되지 않은 지금까지는 월드투어에 계속 출전하도록 허용됐어요. 림종운은 결승 뒤 "빙판 위에서는 눈앞의 레이스만 생각하고 다른 방해 요소는 접어둔다"고 말했어요. 그는 네 선수가 함께 따낸 메달이라 더욱 뜻깊다고 덧붙였어요.

paragraphs.en: Earlier on Sunday, Kim Gil-li took silver in the women's 1,500 meters, finishing behind Elisa Confortola of Italy in the seven-skater final. Failia Aimaletdinova, a Russian skater competing as an Individual Neutral Athlete because of sanctions imposed over her country's invasion of Ukraine, earned the bronze. China's Song Jiarui charged out to the front early and nearly lapped the field before running out of gas, with Choi Min-jeong a distant second. Confortola caught Song with two laps remaining, Kim Gil-li made a late push past Choi and Aimaletdinova, and Choi could not hold on to the bronze position. Kim, a two-time gold medalist at this year's Milan-Cortina Winter Olympics, said it felt great to win her first medal of the season at home. At the second leg in Montreal earlier this month, she had collided in the heats of both the 500 and 1,000 meters and withdrew from the 1,500-meter quarterfinals with an ankle injury. "I think these are all part of my growing process," Kim said, adding that she is still learning how to avoid getting tangled up in such situations.

paragraphs.en: Choi, the sport's most decorated South Korean Olympian with seven career medals, also finished fourth in the women's 500 meters, where three Canadians swept the podium. Courtney Sarault won the gold, Danae Blais took the silver and Florence Brunelle collected the bronze for Canada. South Korea had no finalist in the men's 1,000 meters on Sunday and finished fourth in the 2,000-meter mixed team relay.

paragraphs.en: On Saturday, Choi claimed her third straight World Tour title in the women's 1,000 meters on home ice, passing Sarault on the inside over the final lap. Three laps from the end, Canada's Ann-Sophie Bachand lost her balance and fell, taking down South Korea's Kim Gil-li and leaving Choi, Sarault and Brunelle to contest the medals. Later that day Choi joined Kim Gil-li, Kim Geon-hee and Shim Suk-hee to take silver in the women's 3,000-meter relay behind China, with the AIN team third. Shin won the men's 1,500 meters for his first individual World Tour gold, holding off Jens van't Wout of the Netherlands by 0.006 seconds, with Canada's Felix Roussel third. Teun Boer of the Netherlands won the men's 500 meters ahead of van't Wout and Canada's Mathieu Pelletier, and no South Korean reached that final.
paragraphs.ko: 토요일에 최민정은 홈 링크에서 열린 여자 1000m에서 마지막 바퀴에 안쪽으로 사로를 추월해 월드투어 3연속 우승을 차지했어요. 결승선 3바퀴 전 캐나다의 앤소피 바샹이 균형을 잃고 넘어지며 한국의 김길리까지 쓰러뜨렸고, 최민정과 사로, 브뤼넬이 메달을 다투게 됐어요. 같은 날 최민정은 김길리, 김건희, 심석희와 함께 여자 3000m 계주에서 중국에 이은 은메달을 땄고, AIN 팀이 3위였어요. 신동민은 남자 1500m에서 네덜란드의 옌스 판트바우트를 0.006초 차로 따돌리고 개인 첫 월드투어 금메달을 땄고, 캐나다의 펠릭스 루셀이 3위였어요. 네덜란드의 테윈 보어가 판트바우트와 캐나다의 마티외 펠르티에를 제치고 남자 500m에서 우승했고, 한국 선수는 이 종목 결승에 오르지 못했어요.

She won seven medals at the first two stops of the season, and on Friday she topped her heats in the 500, 1,000 and 1,500 meters. Before arriving in Seoul, she sat second in the overall standings with 408 points, just 16 behind Sarault of Canada. South Koreans had been shut out of medals in the women's 500 meters over the first two stops, and the shortest race has generally been a weak spot.

sents.ko: 한국 선수들은 앞선 두 대회에서 여자 500m 메달을 하나도 따지 못했고, 가장 짧은 이 종목은 대체로 약점이었어요.

paragraphs.en: ISU president Kim Jae-youl said on Sunday that he wants to expand the revamped circuit, adding a competition next season to make it an eight-leg tour. The World Tour replaced the World Cup starting in 2024-2025, with six events in the first season, four in 2025-2026 because of the Olympics, and seven this season. "Short track is hugely popular in South Korea," Kim told a press conference, adding that talks are under way to hold at least one World Tour event in the country every season. Elected in June 2022 as the first non-European head of the federation since its founding in 1892, he won a second term in June this year. He said prize money has doubled this season and that his biggest task in the second term is finding how much more money can be offered to skaters. Kim also said he hopes Choi stays on the ice longer, but that helping her focus on the World Tour and world championships is right for now.
paragraphs.ko: 김재열 ISU 회장은 일요일에 새로 바뀐 투어를 키우고 싶다며 다음 시즌 대회를 하나 더 해 8차 투어로 만들 계획을 밝혔어요. 월드투어는 2024-2025 시즌부터 월드컵을 대체했고, 첫 시즌에는 대회가 여섯 번, 올림픽이 있던 2025-2026 시즌에는 네 번, 이번 시즌에는 일곱 번 열려요. 김 회장은 기자회견에서 "쇼트트랙은 한국에서 매우 인기가 높다"며 매 시즌 한국에서 월드투어를 최소 한 번 열기 위해 협의 중이라고 말했어요. 2022년 6월 1892년 창립 이래 처음으로 비유럽 출신 회장에 선출된 그는 올해 6월 두 번째 임기를 따냈어요. 그는 이번 시즌 상금이 두 배가 됐고, 두 번째 임기의 가장 큰 과제는 선수들에게 얼마나 더 많은 상금을 줄 수 있는지라고 말했어요. 김 회장은 최민정이 더 오래 빙판에 남기를 바라지만, 지금은 월드투어와 세계선수권에 집중하게 돕는 것이 맞다고도 말했어요.

paragraphs.en: The World Tour moves on to its fourth leg in Shanghai, which starts on Friday, while the next season could grow to eight legs. Mokdong Ice Rink will host the world championships in March next year, giving South Korean fans another chance to watch their stars on home ice.

talk.answer: Short track is hugely popular in South Korea, and the home crowd in Seoul watched the hosts win the men's relay. I think success at the Olympics and a strong group of skaters keep fans interested. For me, the sport also shows how teamwork matters, since the relay gold depended on all four skaters.

issues.title: Google Pledges $5 Million to IIT Kharagpur for Applied AI Research, Training and Campus Infrastructure
issues.titleKo: 구글이 인도공과대학 카라그푸르에 응용 AI 연구, 교육, 캠퍼스 인프라를 위해 500만 달러를 약속했어요.
issues.gist: Google has pledged $5 million to IIT Kharagpur to advance applied AI research in Indic languages, agriculture, materials science and educational technology. Alumnus Sundar Pichai was credited with helping facilitate the funding.
issues.gistKo: 구글이 인도공과대학 카라그푸르에 인도어, 농업, 재료과학, 교육 기술 분야의 응용 AI 연구를 위해 500만 달러를 약속했어요. 발표는 개교 75주년 행사에서 나왔고 동문 순다르 피차이가 자금 마련을 도왔다고 해요.
issues.easyKo: 구글이 피차이 CEO의 모교인 인도 대학에 약 500만 달러를 지원하기로 했어요. 이 돈은 AI 연구, AI 교육, 캠퍼스 AI 기반 시설에 나뉘어 쓰여요.

paragraphs.en: Google has pledged $5 million to the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur to strengthen advanced artificial intelligence research, expand educational opportunities and help develop the next generation of technology professionals, a senior institute official told the Press Trust of India on Sunday. The announcement came on November 21 during the institute's platinum jubilee celebrations, which mark its 75th anniversary, and Indian outlets carried the news the same day and into November 22. The Open Press put the amount at about Rs 46 crore, and it described the move as a major investment by Google chief executive Sundar Pichai in his alma mater.
paragraphs.ko: 구글이 인도공과대학 카라그푸르에 AI 연구 강화, 교육 기회 확대, 차세대 기술 인재 양성을 위해 500만 달러를 약속했다고 이 대학 고위 관계자가 일요일 프레스트러스트오브인디아에 밝혔어요. 발표는 11월 21일 개교 75주년을 기념하는 이 대학의 플래티넘 주빌리 행사에서 나왔고, 인도 매체들이 같은 날부터 11월 22일까지 이를 보도했어요. 디 오픈 프레스는 금액이 약 46크로르 루피라며, 구글 최고경영자 순다르 피차이가 모교에 하는 큰 투자라고 설명했어요.

sents.en: Google has pledged $5 million to the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur to strengthen advanced artificial intelligence research, expand educational opportunities and help develop the next generation of technology professionals, a senior institute official told the Press Trust of India on Sunday.

sents.ko: 디 오픈 프레스는 금액이 약 46크로르 루피라며, 구글 최고경영자 순다르 피차이가 모교에 하는 큰 투자라고 설명했어요.

paragraphs.en: According to the institute, the money will be channelled through three broad areas, namely advanced AI research, educational opportunities such as expanded AI training and curriculum for students and faculty, and capacity building through campus AI infrastructure, frameworks and tools. The Open Press reported that the education pillar extends AI training and curriculum development to teachers as well as students and faculty, in an effort to broaden access to AI learning. The third pillar is meant to strengthen the institute's AI frameworks, tools and infrastructure so that research can scale across the entire campus rather than staying in a few laboratories.
paragraphs.ko: 대학에 따르면 이 돈은 세 갈래, 곧 고급 AI 연구, 학생과 교수진을 위한 AI 교육과 교육과정 확대 같은 교육 기회, 캠퍼스 AI 인프라와 도구를 통한 역량 강화로 쓰여요. 디 오픈 프레스는 교육 부문이 학생과 교수진뿐 아니라 교사에게도 AI 교육과 교육과정 개발을 넓혀 AI 학습의 문턱을 낮추려는 것이라고 전했어요. 세 번째 부문은 이 대학의 AI 틀과 도구, 기반 시설을 강화해 연구가 몇몇 연구실에 머물지 않고 캠퍼스 전체로 커지게 하려는 것이에요.

sents.en: According to the institute, the money will be channelled through three broad areas, namely advanced AI research, educational opportunities such as expanded AI training and curriculum for students and faculty, and capacity building through campus AI infrastructure, frameworks and tools.

sents.en: The Open Press reported that the education pillar extends AI training and curriculum development to teachers as well as students and faculty, in an effort to broaden access to AI learning.

paragraphs.en: Under the research pillar, the funding will primarily support applied AI research in four areas, namely Indic languages, agriculture, materials science and educational technology, according to the director's comments to the Press Trust of India. The Open Press described the aims as language tools that work in Indian languages, AI that helps farmers and improves crop outcomes, faster discovery of new materials through machine learning, and classroom technology that reaches more learners. Google said the effort is designed to broaden access to AI learning and to equip future professionals with skills for an increasingly AI-driven economy.
paragraphs.ko: 연구 부문에서는 이 대학 총장의 프레스트러스트오브인디아 발언에 따르면 인도어, 농업, 재료과학, 교육 기술 네 분야의 응용 AI 연구를 주로 지원해요. 디 오픈 프레스는 목표를 인도 언어로 작동하는 언어 도구, 농부를 돕고 수확을 높이는 AI, 기계학습으로 빨라진 신소재 발견, 더 많은 학습자에게 닿는 교실 기술로 설명했어요. 구글은 이 노력이 AI 학습의 접근성을 넓히고 갈수록 AI가 이끄는 경제에서 미래 인재가 쓸 기술을 갖추게 하려는 것이라고 말했어요.

sents.en: Under the research pillar, the funding will primarily support applied AI research in four areas, namely Indic languages, agriculture, materials science and educational technology, according to the director's comments to the Press Trust of India.
sents.ko: 연구 부문에서는 이 대학 총장의 프레스트러스트오브인디아 발언에 따르면 인도어, 농업, 재료과학, 교육 기술 네 분야의 응용 AI 연구를 주로 지원해요.

sents.en: The Open Press described the aims as language tools that work in Indian languages, AI that helps farmers and improves crop outcomes, faster discovery of new materials through machine learning, and classroom technology that reaches more learners.
sents.ko: 디 오픈 프레스는 목표를 인도 언어로 작동하는 언어 도구, 농부를 돕고 수확을 높이는 AI, 기계학습으로 빨라진 신소재 발견, 더 많은 학습자에게 닿는 교실 기술로 설명했어요.

sents.en: Google said the effort is designed to broaden access to AI learning and to equip future professionals with skills for an increasingly AI-driven economy.
sents.ko: 구글은 이 노력이 AI 학습의 접근성을 넓히고 갈수록 AI가 이끄는 경제에서 미래 인재가 쓸 기술을 갖추게 하려는 것이라고 말했어요.

paragraphs.en: IIT Kharagpur Director Suman Chakraborty told the news agency that Sundar Pichai, an alumnus of the institute and the head of Google, played a key role in facilitating the funding. Chakraborty said the institute is proud of its alumnus who heads Google, thanked the company for the pledge, and added that Pichai assisted in securing the money. Announcing the collaboration, Pichai said IIT Kharagpur is already producing impactful work in Indic languages, agriculture and education, and that Google is excited to help accelerate that impact. According to The Open Press, he said he hopes the partnership will shape the next generation of students just as the institute influenced his own journey.
paragraphs.ko: 이 대학의 수만 차크라보르티 총장은 통신사에 이 대학 동문이자 구글 수장인 순다르 피차이가 자금을 끌어오는 데 핵심 역할을 했다고 말했어요. 차크라보르티는 구글을 이끄는 동문이 자랑스럽다며 이번 약속에 대해 회사에 감사했고, 피차이가 자금을 확보하도록 도왔다고 덧붙였어요. 협력을 알리며 피차이는 이 대학이 이미 인도어, 농업, 교육에서 영향력 있는 연구를 하고 있고 구글이 그 영향을 앞당기도록 돕게 돼 기쁘다고 말했어요. 디 오픈 프레스에 따르면 그는 이 대학이 자신의 여정에 영향을 주었듯 이번 협력이 다음 세대 학생들을 키우길 바란다고 말했어요.

paragraphs.en: Chakraborty also said that another alumnus, Jyoti Chatterjee, had pledged an additional $5 million as a seed endowment for developing a next-generation data initiative, which is a separate commitment from Google's grant. The Open Press noted that the partnership arrives as India sharpens its focus on building domestic AI capability, with the central government backing homegrown models and computing infrastructure under the Rs 10,371-crore IndiaAI Mission. Pichai said programmes like this one will help carry forward Prime Minister Narendra Modi's vision that the benefits of AI reach everyone in India. The funding adds to a wider push by global technology companies to invest in Indian research talent, with the IITs at the centre of that effort. The institute said the contributions are expected to give a major boost to its efforts to expand AI-driven innovation and to enhance its role in developing skilled technology professionals.
paragraphs.ko: 차크라보르티는 또 다른 동문 조티 채터지가 차세대 데이터 사업을 위한 종잣돈 기금으로 추가 500만 달러를 약속했다고 말했는데, 이는 구글의 지원과는 별개의 약속이에요. 디 오픈 프레스는 인도가 국내 AI 역량 구축에 힘을 쏟는 때에 이번 협력이 나왔다며, 중앙정부가 1조 371억 루피 규모 인디아AI 미션으로 자국산 모델과 컴퓨팅 기반을 지원한다고 짚었어요. 피차이는 이런 사업이 AI의 혜택이 인도의 모든 사람에게 닿게 하겠다는 나렌드라 모디 총리의 구상을 이어 가는 데 도움이 될 것이라고 말했어요. 이번 자금은 인도 연구 인재에 투자하려는 글로벌 기술 기업들의 더 큰 흐름에 보태지며, 인도공과대학들이 그 중심에 있어요. 대학은 이 기부들이 AI 기반 혁신을 넓히고 숙련된 기술 인재를 길러 내는 역할을 키우려는 노력에 큰 힘이 될 것으로 기대한다고 밝혔어요.

views.view: The director thanked Google and credited alumnus Pichai, saying the funding will mainly support applied AI research in four areas.
Calls it a major investment by Pichai in his alma mater, fitting India's push for homegrown AI capability under the IndiaAI Mission.
Notes the grant is small beside AI industry deals and that the announcement leaves schedule and duration unspecified.

heads.title: Google pledges $5 mn to IIT Kharagpur for AI research
Google invests $5 million in AI research at IIT Kharagpur

why: Corporate AI funding for Indian universities shapes where the next generation of AI researchers is trained.
It also ties Google's name to India's drive to build its own AI talent.
lines.agree: Every report agrees on the $5 million figure, the three pillars and the four research areas, with Sundar Pichai credited for helping facilitate it.
lines.life: For Korean students, it shows how big tech companies fund university AI labs abroad, which can mean research partnerships and exchange chances.
lines.next: Watch for details on project lists, schedules and how the money is split among research, education and infrastructure.

issues.title: North Korea Moves Pyongyang Marathon From April to October as Tour Agency Cites No Reason
issues.titleKo: 북한이 평양마라톤을 4월에서 10월로 옮겼고 여행사는 이유를 밝히지 않았어요
issues.gist: North Korea plans to shift its 2027 Pyongyang International Marathon from April to October, a Beijing-based tour agency said, ending a decades-old link to Kim Il-sung's birthday. The agency gave no reason, and the date is not yet officially confirmed.
issues.gistKo: 북한이 2027년 평양국제마라톤을 4월에서 10월로 옮기려 한다고 베이징 소재 여행사가 밝혔고, 김일성 생일과 이어진 수십 년 전통이 끊겨요. 여행사는 이유를 밝히지 않았고 날짜도 아직 공식 확정되지 않았어요.
issues.easyKo: 북한이 해마다 4월에 열던 평양 마라톤을 내년에는 10월에 열겠다고 해요. 이 소식은 북한과 거래하는 여행사가 전했고, 왜 바꿨는지는 알려지지 않았어요.

glosses.meaning: 평양국제마라톤(북한 평양에서 열리는 국제 마라톤 대회)

재치 있는 단서(씁쓸한 농담 섞인 단서)
조선인민혁명군(북한이 항일 무장 조직으로 내세우는 군대)

views.view: Koryo Tours says the 2027 race will be held in October and that the exact date will be announced once officially confirmed.
The newspaper notes the change breaks a decades-old tie to Kim Il-sung's April birthday, but says it is unclear whether April anniversaries played any role.
The wire describes the race as the isolated state's largest international sporting event and recalls that this year's edition was canceled with no reason given.
Reuters reports the postponement as announced by the tour agency, which says October is almost certain.

heads.title: North Korea postpones 2027 Pyongyang International Marathon
N. Korea moves April marathon honoring founder’s birthday to October
N. Korea to hold int'l Pyongyang marathon in Oct. 2027: tour agency
North Korea delays international marathon until October: tour agency

why: The race is North Korea's biggest window for foreign visitors, so a change of date hints at shifting priorities in the closed state's tourism and sports diplomacy.
It also severs a decades-old link between the marathon and the founder's April 15 birthday.
lines.agree: All outlets agree that Koryo Tours says the race will move to October 2027, citing the Pyongyang organizing committee, with no reason given.
lines.split: The Korea Herald floats the April anniversaries as context, but stresses that nothing confirms they caused the move.
lines.life: Korean students who follow inter-Korean affairs can use this as an example of how limited news from the North often arrives through third parties.
lines.next: Watch for Koryo Tours to confirm an exact date, likely Oct. 3, and for North Korea to announce its April 2027 anniversary events.

issues.job: 북한의 대외 개방 · 관광 정책이 어떻게 움직이는지 = 「남북 관계 · 국제 스포츠 교류」 질문에 쓸 수 있어요.

talk.q: What does the marathon's date change tell you about how North Korea manages contact with the outside world?
talk.qKo: 마라톤 날짜 변경은 북한이 외부 세계와의 접촉을 어떻게 관리하는지에 대해 무엇을 알려 주나요?
talk.answer: The race has been canceled once and now rescheduled, and no reason was given either time. That suggests decisions are made centrally and communicated mostly through outside partners such as tour agencies. I think reading the signals carefully matters more than guessing the cause.
talk.answerKo: 대회는 한 번 취소됐고 이번에 일정이 바뀌었는데, 두 번 모두 이유가 공개되지 않았어요. 결정이 중앙에서 내려지고 주로 여행사 같은 외부 파트너를 통해 전해진다는 뜻으로 보여요. 원인을 짐작하기보다 신호를 신중하게 읽는 것이 더 중요하다고 생각해요.

paragraphs.en: North Korea has postponed its 2027 Pyongyang International Marathon from April to October, a Beijing-based tour agency that serves as the race's exclusive travel partner announced over the weekend. Koryo Tours said on its website on Saturday that organizers in Pyongyang had informed it of the change, and that the event would not be held in April as usual. "It will not take place in April 2027," the agency wrote, adding that it was "almost certain" the race would instead be staged in October of that year. The company gave no reason for the shift and said it hoped to have a fully confirmed date in good time.
paragraphs.ko: 북한이 2027년 평양국제마라톤을 4월에서 10월로 미뤘다고, 이 대회의 독점 여행 파트너인 베이징 소재 여행사가 주말에 밝혔어요. 고려투어는 토요일 자사 웹사이트에서 평양의 주최 측이 일정 변경을 알려 왔으며 대회가 평소처럼 4월에 열리지 않는다고 밝혔어요. 여행사는 "2027년 4월에는 열리지 않는다"고 적고, 대신 같은 해 10월에 열릴 것이 "거의 확실하다"고 덧붙였어요. 여행사는 일정 변경의 이유를 밝히지 않았고, 확정된 날짜를 충분히 일찍 알리기를 바란다고 말했어요.

sents.en: North Korea has postponed its 2027 Pyongyang International Marathon from April to October, a Beijing-based tour agency that serves as the race's exclusive travel partner announced over the weekend.

sents.en: Koryo Tours said on its website on Saturday that organizers in Pyongyang had informed it of the change, and that the event would not be held in April as usual.

sents.en: "It will not take place in April 2027," the agency wrote, adding that it was "almost certain" the race would instead be staged in October of that year.
sents.ko: 여행사는 "2027년 4월에는 열리지 않는다"고 적고, 대신 같은 해 10월에 열릴 것이 "거의 확실하다"고 덧붙였어요.

paragraphs.en: According to the Korea Herald, the Pyongyang International Marathon will most likely take place on Oct. 3, 2027, although the exact date has yet to be confirmed by the North Korean side. Yonhap News Agency reported that Koryo Tours made the announcement in a social media post on Sunday and promised to publish the precise date once it is officially confirmed. The agency also hedged on the venue, saying the marathon was expected to take place in Pyongyang, "at least", a wry caveat that reflects the uncertainty surrounding events in the isolated state.
paragraphs.ko: 코리아헤럴드에 따르면 평양국제마라톤은 2027년 10월 3일에 열릴 가능성이 가장 높지만, 정확한 날짜는 북한 쪽에서 아직 확정되지 않았어요. 연합뉴스는 고려투어가 일요일 소셜 미디어 글로 이 소식을 알렸으며 공식 확정되면 정확한 날짜를 공개하겠다고 약속했다고 전했어요. 여행사는 개최 장소에 대해서도 말을 아끼며 마라톤이 "적어도" 평양에서 열릴 것으로 예상된다고 했는데, 고립된 국가에서 열리는 행사를 둘러싼 불확실성을 보여 주는 재치 있는 단서였어요.

paragraphs.en: If the race goes ahead as planned, it would break with a tradition stretching back to 1981, when North Korea first staged the marathon to mark the April 15 birthday of its founding leader, Kim Il-sung. The event was originally known as the Mangyongdae Prize International Marathon, named after the district of Pyongyang where Kim was born, and it was renamed the Pyongyang International Marathon in 2023. It opened to foreign amateur runners in 2014, offering overseas participants a rare chance to run through the streets of the tightly controlled capital.
paragraphs.ko: 대회가 계획대로 열리면 북한이 1981년 건국 지도자 김일성의 4월 15일 생일을 기념해 처음 마라톤을 연 이래 이어진 전통을 깨게 돼요. 이 대회는 원래 김일성이 태어난 평양 지역의 이름을 딴 만경대상 국제마라톤으로 불렸고, 2023년 평양국제마라톤으로 이름이 바뀌었어요. 2014년에는 외국인 아마추어 주자에게 문을 열어, 통제가 심한 수도의 거리를 달려 볼 드문 기회를 해외 참가자들에게 주었어요.

paragraphs.en: The marathon was not held for five consecutive years starting in 2020 because of the COVID-19 pandemic, before it resumed in April 2025 and drew both North Korean and foreign runners. AFP reported that last year's race attracted about 200 foreign runners, who competed alongside more than 200 North Koreans, and that local athletes won both the men's and women's events. That foreign turnout was far below 2019, when roughly 950 foreigners took part, and the event is widely regarded as the isolated country's largest international sporting occasion.
paragraphs.ko: 마라톤은 코로나19 대유행 때문에 2020년부터 5년 연속 열리지 못했고, 2025년 4월에 재개되어 북한 주자와 외국인 주자가 함께 참가했어요. AFP는 지난해 대회에 외국인 주자 약 200명이 북한 주자 200명 넘게와 함께 달렸고, 남녀 경기 모두 북한 선수가 우승했다고 전했어요. 그 외국인 참가자 수는 약 950명이 참가한 2019년보다 훨씬 적었고, 이 대회는 고립된 나라에서 열리는 가장 큰 국제 스포츠 행사로 널리 여겨져요.

sents.en: The marathon was not held for five consecutive years starting in 2020 because of the COVID-19 pandemic, before it resumed in April 2025 and drew both North Korean and foreign runners.
sents.ko: 마라톤은 코로나19 대유행 때문에 2020년부터 5년 연속 열리지 못했고, 2025년 4월에 재개되어 북한 주자와 외국인 주자가 함께 참가했어요.

paragraphs.en: This year's edition, scheduled for April 5, was abruptly canceled in March, less than a month before the start, after Koryo Tours had already promoted travel packages to recruit foreign participants. The agency said at the time that the decision had been confirmed by North Korea's athletics association, and no explanation was given for the cancellation.
paragraphs.ko: 올해 대회는 4월 5일로 예정되어 있었지만 고려투어가 이미 외국인 참가자를 모으려고 여행 상품을 홍보한 뒤인 3월, 개최 한 달도 남기지 않고 갑자기 취소됐어요. 여행사는 당시 이 결정이 북한 육상협회를 통해 확인됐다고 밝혔고, 취소 이유는 설명되지 않았어요.

sents.en: This year's edition, scheduled for April 5, was abruptly canceled in March, less than a month before the start, after Koryo Tours had already promoted travel packages to recruit foreign participants.
sents.ko: 올해 대회는 4월 5일로 예정되어 있었지만 고려투어가 이미 외국인 참가자를 모으려고 여행 상품을 홍보한 뒤인 3월, 개최 한 달도 남기지 않고 갑자기 취소됐어요.

sents.en: The agency said at the time that the decision had been confirmed by North Korea's athletics association, and no explanation was given for the cancellation.

paragraphs.en: The Korea Herald noted that the timing of the latest change is notable because North Korea will mark several major political anniversaries in April 2027. Leader Kim Jong-un will mark 15 years since he formally consolidated power in April 2012, when he was named first secretary of the ruling Workers' Party on April 11 and first chairman of the National Defense Commission two days later. On April 15 the country will observe the 115th anniversary of Kim Il-sung's birth, and ten days later it will commemorate the 95th anniversary of the founding of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army.
paragraphs.ko: 코리아헤럴드는 북한이 2027년 4월에 여러 중요한 정치 기념일을 맞기 때문에 이번 일정 변경 시기가 눈길을 끈다고 짚었어요. 김정은 지도자는 2012년 4월 11일 집권 노동당 제1비서에, 이틀 뒤 국방위원회 제1위원장에 오르며 공식적으로 권력을 굳힌 지 15년이 되는 날을 맞아요. 4월 15일에는 김일성 탄생 115주년을 기념하고, 열흘 뒤에는 조선인민혁명군 창건 95주년을 기념해요.

sents.en: The Korea Herald noted that the timing of the latest change is notable because North Korea will mark several major political anniversaries in April 2027.

paragraphs.en: North Korea attaches particular significance to anniversaries that fall on five- or 10-year milestones and often marks them with elaborate celebrations and military displays. In April 2022, when the same three anniversaries reached their previous five-year milestones, Pyongyang held a series of commemorative events, including a large nighttime military parade on April 25. The Korea Herald said it remained unclear whether preparations for next year's anniversaries played any role, and it noted that North Korea has not announced plans for major commemorations in April 2027. The newspaper also pointed out that a similar cluster of anniversaries did not stop the marathon from being held on April 9, 2017, just ahead of celebrations for Kim Il-sung's 105th birthday.
paragraphs.ko: 북한은 5년이나 10년 단위로 돌아오는 기념일을 특히 중시해 화려한 기념행사와 군사 퍼레이드로 치르는 경우가 많아요. 같은 세 기념일이 직전 5년 단위를 맞았던 2022년 4월에 평양은 4월 25일 대규모 야간 열병식을 포함한 여러 기념행사를 열었어요. 코리아헤럴드는 내년 기념일 준비가 영향을 미쳤는지는 분명하지 않으며 북한이 2027년 4월 대규모 기념행사 계획을 발표하지 않았다고 전했어요. 이 신문은 비슷하게 기념일이 몰렸던 2017년에도 김일성 105번째 생일 행사를 앞둔 4월 9일에 마라톤이 열렸다고 짚었어요.

issues.title: Upbit and Bithumb Freeze CYBER Transfers After Suspected Bridge Exploit Mints 5.2 Million Tokens
issues.titleKo: 업비트와 빗썸이 브리지 공격 의혹으로 520만 개 토큰이 발행된 CYBER의 이체를 중단했어요
issues.gist: South Korea's biggest crypto exchanges, Upbit and Bithumb, halted CYBER deposits and withdrawals after a suspected attack on the project's cross-chain bridge minted about 5.21 million unbacked tokens. The proceeds, reportedly about $1 million, were swapped for ether as Cyber investigates.
issues.gistKo: 한국 최대 가상자산 거래소인 업비트와 빗썸이 프로젝트의 크로스체인 브리지 공격 의혹으로 담보 없는 토큰 약 521만 개가 발행되자 CYBER 입출금을 중단했어요. 약 100만 달러로 알려진 수익은 이더로 바뀌었고 사이버는 조사 중이에요.
issues.easyKo: 누군가 사이버라는 코인의 다리(브리지)를 속여 가짜 코인을 대량으로 만들어 팔았다는 의혹이 나왔어요. 그래서 업비트와 빗썸이 이 코인의 입금과 출금을 잠시 막았어요.

glosses.meaning: 크로스체인 브리지(서로 다른 블록체인 사이에 자산을 옮기는 다리)
레이어2 네트워크(이더리움 위에서 처리를 돕는 별도 망)
보관함(브리지에 묶어 둔 토큰 저장 계약)
차익거래자(거래소 가격 차이로 이익 보는 사람)

views.view: Cyber reported unexpected minting on Solana and tokens leaving its Ethereum lockbox, and the Korean exchanges paused transfers while the project investigates.
The outlet warns that about 5.21 million unbacked tokens change the supply math for holders and that exchanges now effectively set the rules until Cyber explains.
The outlet traces the on-chain flows, from the minting to the swaps into ETH, and notes that neither exchange had restored transfers by Nov. 22.
The outlet reports Cyber's warning to users and the roughly 8 percent price drop before a partial recovery.
The outlet summarizes the exchange suspensions and attributes the loss estimate to Crypto Briefing, noting Cyber has not confirmed a final figure.

heads.title: Cyber bridge exploit mints 5.21 million CYBER tokens, Upbit and Bithumb freeze transfers
South Korean exchanges halt CYBER transfers amid suspected bridge exploit
Cyber Probes $1M Bridge Exploit as Upbit, Bithumb Halt CYBER Transfers
Upbit, Bithumb Freeze CYBER as 5.21M Tokens Leave Bridge
Upbit and Bithumb halt CYBER token transfers after a suspected bridge exploit mints 5 million tokens

why: Bridge exploits let attackers create tokens from nothing, so exchanges must decide quickly whether to block transfers before tainted coins reach their customers.
The episode also tests how Korean exchanges act on suspicion alone, just as regulators plan to formalize that power.
lines.agree: Every report agrees that Upbit and Bithumb suspended CYBER deposits and withdrawals and that Cyber has urged users to avoid its bridge.
lines.split: Outlets differ on loss size, with some citing about $968,000 in sale proceeds and others a suspected $1 million exploit, and Cyber has confirmed neither.
lines.life: Students who trade or hold crypto on Korean exchanges can see how a suspended deposit and withdrawal window leaves tokens tradable but impossible to move.
lines.next: Watch for a fuller statement from Cyber, any decision by Upbit and Bithumb to restore transfers, and the Financial Services Commission's rule on suspected hacks.

paragraphs.en: South Korea's two largest cryptocurrency exchanges, Upbit and Bithumb, suspended deposits and withdrawals of the CYBER token after its developer reported a suspected exploit of a cross-chain bridge. Cyber, a project formerly known as CyberConnect that runs an Ethereum layer-2 network designed for social applications, said on Saturday that it had detected unexpected minting of CYBER on Solana. That minting was followed by a transfer of CYBER out of the bridge's Ethereum lockbox, and the team said it was checking which assets and bridge routes had been affected.
paragraphs.ko: 한국의 양대 가상자산 거래소인 업비트와 빗썸이 개발사가 크로스체인 브리지 공격 의혹을 알린 뒤 사이버(CYBER) 토큰의 입출금을 중단했어요. 예전에 사이버커넥트로 불렸고 소셜 애플리케이션용 이더리움 레이어2 네트워크를 운영하는 사이버는 토요일 솔라나에서 CYBER가 예상치 못하게 발행된 것을 발견했다고 밝혔어요. 이 발행에 이어 브리지의 이더리움 보관함에서 CYBER가 빠져나갔고, 팀은 어떤 자산과 브리지 경로가 영향을 받았는지 확인하고 있다고 했어요.

sents.en: South Korea's two largest cryptocurrency exchanges, Upbit and Bithumb, suspended deposits and withdrawals of the CYBER token after its developer reported a suspected exploit of a cross-chain bridge.
sents.ko: 한국의 양대 가상자산 거래소인 업비트와 빗썸이 개발사가 크로스체인 브리지 공격 의혹을 알린 뒤 사이버(CYBER) 토큰의 입출금을 중단했어요.

sents.ko: 예전에 사이버커넥트로 불렸고 소셜 애플리케이션용 이더리움 레이어2 네트워크를 운영하는 사이버는 토요일 솔라나에서 CYBER가 예상치 못하게 발행된 것을 발견했다고 밝혔어요.

paragraphs.en: Transaction records cited by Upbit show that an address minted 5,213,000 CYBER on Solana at 11:13 a.m. Eastern time, and that the same amount left an Ethereum contract called CyberTokenAdapter two minutes later. That contract secures tokens for Cyber's bridge, which is built on the LayerZero messaging protocol, and the receiving wallet had been funded less than an hour earlier, according to the same records. Crypto Briefing, citing research findings on the event, said forged bridge messages that misrepresented the tokens' legitimacy passed normal validation and let the attacker create unbacked CYBER while draining real tokens from the Ethereum escrow.
paragraphs.ko: 업비트가 인용한 거래 기록에 따르면 한 주소가 동부 시간 오전 11시 13분 솔라나에서 CYBER 5,213,000개를 발행했고, 2분 뒤 같은 양이 CyberTokenAdapter라는 이더리움 계약에서 빠져나갔어요. 이 계약은 레이어제로 메시징 프로토콜 위에 만들어진 사이버 브리지의 토큰을 보관하며, 같은 기록에 따르면 받은 지갑은 한 시간도 안 전에 자금이 채워졌어요. 크립토 브리핑은 이 사건에 관한 연구 결과를 인용해, 토큰의 정당성을 속인 위조 브리지 메시지가 일반 검증을 통과해 공격자가 담보 없는 CYBER를 만들고 이더리움 에스크로의 진짜 토큰을 빼냈다고 전했어요.

paragraphs.en: Two wallets then sold most of the tokens through the decentralized trading services KyberSwap and MetaMask Swaps, converting them into ether, while another 412,000 CYBER moved to three unidentified wallets. The wallets transferred 575.29 ETH to a newly created address, proceeds that Crypto Briefing valued at roughly $968,000 at the time and said were still sitting with the attacker. Several outlets called the incident a suspected $1 million exploit, and no public indication has emerged that any of the funds have been frozen or recovered.
paragraphs.ko: 이어 지갑 두 개가 탈중앙화 거래 서비스인 카이버스왑과 메타마스크 스왑으로 토큰 대부분을 팔아 이더로 바꿨고, 다른 CYBER 412,000개는 신원 미상의 지갑 세 곳으로 옮겨졌어요. 지갑들은 575.29 ETH를 새로 만든 주소로 보냈는데, 크립토 브리핑은 이 수익을 당시 약 96만 8천 달러로 계산했고 아직 공격자에게 있다고 전했어요. 여러 매체가 이번 사건을 100만 달러 규모의 공격 의혹이라고 불렀고, 자금이 동결되거나 회수됐다는 공개 정보는 나오지 않았어요.

paragraphs.en: Bithumb said on Sunday that it had detected suspected security issues involving CYBER transfers, adding that trading would continue and that transfers would resume once the network was judged stable. Upbit announced a temporary halt to CYBER deposits and withdrawals and warned users of possible price volatility, and neither exchange had restored transfers as of Nov. 22, GNcrypto reported. Crypto Briefing noted that stopping transfers while allowing trading can leave prices on different venues drifting apart, because arbitrage traders cannot move tokens between exchanges.
paragraphs.ko: 빗썸은 일요일 CYBER 이체와 관련해 보안 문제가 의심된다고 밝히면서, 거래는 계속되고 네트워크가 안정됐다고 판단되면 이체를 재개하겠다고 말했어요. 업비트는 CYBER 입출금을 임시로 중단한다고 알리고 가격 변동 가능성을 이용자에게 경고했으며, GN크립토에 따르면 11월 22일 현재 두 거래소 모두 이체를 재개하지 않았어요. 크립토 브리핑은 이체를 막고 거래만 허용하면 차익거래자들이 거래소 사이에 토큰을 옮길 수 없어 거래소별 가격이 벌어질 수 있다고 짚었어요.

paragraphs.en: The token fell about 8 percent to $0.2024 after the incident before recovering to around $0.2130, according to Coin Edition and GNcrypto. Cyber urged users not to use its bridge, deposit CYBER to exchanges, connect wallets or migrate tokens while it investigates, but it has not issued a fuller public explanation or confirmed a final loss figure. Crypto Briefing added that any decision by Upbit or Bithumb to restore transfers will likely hinge on clarity that only the project itself can provide.
paragraphs.ko: 코인에디션과 GN크립토에 따르면 토큰은 사건 뒤 약 8% 하락해 0.2024달러까지 떨어졌다가 0.2130달러 안팎으로 회복했어요. 사이버는 조사하는 동안 브리지를 쓰거나 CYBER를 거래소에 입금하거나 지갑을 연결하거나 토큰을 옮기지 말라고 당부했지만, 더 자세한 공개 설명이나 최종 피해액 확인은 내놓지 않았어요. 크립토 브리핑은 업비트나 빗썸이 이체를 재개할지는 프로젝트만이 줄 수 있는 설명에 달려 있을 것이라고 덧붙였어요.

paragraphs.en: The freezes come days after South Korea's Financial Services Commission announced plans to let exchanges halt deposits and withdrawals when hacking is suspected, rather than waiting for a confirmed breach, Cointelegraph noted. Earlier this month, the Korean exchange GOPAX also suspended trading, deposits and standard withdrawals after receiving a hacking threat, even though it said no breach had occurred. Cyber rebranded from CyberConnect in May 2024 and disclosed earlier this month that it had completed about $13 million in CYBER token buybacks over the previous year.
paragraphs.ko: 코인텔레그래프는 이번 중단이 금융위원회가 해킹이 확인될 때까지 기다리지 않고 의심만으로도 거래소가 입출금을 멈추게 하겠다는 계획을 발표한 지 며칠 만에 나왔다고 짚었어요. 이번 달 초에는 한국 거래소 고팍스도 해킹 위협을 받은 뒤 침해는 없었다고 밝히면서도 거래와 입금, 일반 출금을 중단했어요. 사이버는 2024년 5월 사이버커넥트에서 이름을 바꿨고, 이번 달 초 지난 1년간 약 1,300만 달러어치 CYBER 토큰을 되사들였다고 공개했어요.

issues.titleKo: 미주리주 판사가 라운드업 암 소송에 대한 바이엘의 72억 5천만 달러 합의를 승인했어요.
issues.gist: A Missouri judge gave final approval on Friday to Bayer's $7.25 billion settlement of claims that its Roundup weedkiller causes cancer. The deal, covering current and future lymphoma claims, could end litigation that has hung over the German company for nearly a decade.
issues.gistKo: 미주리주 판사가 금요일 라운드업 제초제가 암을 일으킨다는 청구에 대한 바이엘의 72억 5천만 달러 합의를 최종 승인했어요. 현재와 미래의 림프종 청구를 아우르는 이 합의로 독일 기업을 거의 10년 괴롭힌 소송이 끝날 수 있어요.
issues.easyKo: 제초제를 쓰고 암에 걸렸다는 사람들이 바이엘을 상대로 낸 수만 건의 소송을 큰 돈을 내고 한꺼번에 끝내기로 했고, 판사가 이를 허락했어요. 다만 항소가 나오면 돈을 받는 시기가 늦어질 수 있어요.

paragraphs.en: A Missouri state court judge on Friday gave final approval to Bayer's $7.25 billion settlement of lawsuits alleging that its Roundup weedkiller causes cancer, ending a long-running fight over the product. Judge Timothy Boyer of the St. Louis court called the deal fair, reasonable and adequate, a ruling that could resolve litigation that has weighed on the German company for close to a decade. NPR reported that the judge described the agreement as among the largest in the history of mass tort personal-injury class action settlements.
paragraphs.ko: 미주리주 주 법원 판사가 금요일, 제초제 라운드업이 암을 일으킨다고 주장하는 소송들을 정리하는 바이엘의 72억 5천만 달러 합의를 최종 승인했어요. 세인트루이스 법원의 티머시 보이어 판사는 이 합의가 공정하고 합리적이며 충분하다고 판단했고, 이 판결로 독일 기업 바이엘을 거의 10년간 짓눌러 온 소송이 정리될 수 있어요. NPR는 판사가 이 합의를 집단 불법행위 인신 피해 집단소송 합의 가운데 역사상 가장 큰 축에 든다고 설명했다고 전했어요.

sents.en: A Missouri state court judge on Friday gave final approval to Bayer's $7.25 billion settlement of lawsuits alleging that its Roundup weedkiller causes cancer, ending a long-running fight over the product.

sents.en: Judge Timothy Boyer of the St. Louis court called the deal fair, reasonable and adequate, a ruling that could resolve litigation that has weighed on the German company for close to a decade.
sents.ko: 세인트루이스 법원의 티머시 보이어 판사는 이 합의가 공정하고 합리적이며 충분하다고 판단했고, 이 판결로 독일 기업 바이엘을 거의 10년간 짓눌러 온 소송이 정리될 수 있어요.

sents.en: NPR reported that the judge described the agreement as among the largest in the history of mass tort personal-injury class action settlements.

paragraphs.en: Bayer had faced roughly 65,000 claims in American state and federal courts from people who said they developed non-Hodgkin lymphoma or other cancers after using Roundup at home or on the job. The settlement, announced in February, is meant to settle nearly all current and future Roundup claims in the United States through a single nationwide class action filed in Missouri state court. It covers people exposed to the weedkiller before Feb. 17, 2026, who have a lymphoma diagnosis now or receive one during a 16-year coverage period, according to MedicalDaily.
paragraphs.ko: 바이엘은 집이나 일터에서 라운드업을 쓴 뒤 비호지킨 림프종 같은 암에 걸렸다고 주장하는 사람들로부터 미국 주 법원과 연방 법원에서 약 6만 5천 건의 청구를 받고 있었어요. 2월에 발표된 이 합의는 미주리주 주 법원에 낸 전국 단위 집단소송 하나로 미국 안의 현재와 미래 라운드업 청구 거의 전부를 정리하려는 것이에요. 메디컬데일리에 따르면 합의는 2026년 2월 17일 전에 제초제에 노출됐고 지금 림프종 진단을 받았거나 16년의 적용 기간 안에 진단받는 사람을 대상으로 해요.

sents.en: Bayer had faced roughly 65,000 claims in American state and federal courts from people who said they developed non-Hodgkin lymphoma or other cancers after using Roundup at home or on the job.
sents.ko: 바이엘은 집이나 일터에서 라운드업을 쓴 뒤 비호지킨 림프종 같은 암에 걸렸다고 주장하는 사람들로부터 미국 주 법원과 연방 법원에서 약 6만 5천 건의 청구를 받고 있었어요.

paragraphs.en: Under the plan, Bayer's Monsanto unit will make declining, capped annual payments for up to 21 years, totaling up to $7.25 billion including money already paid. The agreement requires no admission of liability or wrongdoing, and Bayer has long maintained that Roundup and its active ingredient, glyphosate, are safe because decades of studies show no link to cancer. Bayer chief executive Bill Anderson called the final approval a decisive milestone in the company's strategy to mitigate the risks of pending and future Roundup litigation.
paragraphs.ko: 이 계획에 따라 바이엘의 몬산토 부문은 이미 낸 돈을 포함해 최대 72억 5천만 달러를 한도로, 점차 줄어드는 연간 지급을 최장 21년 동안 해요. 합의에는 책임이나 잘못을 인정하는 내용이 없고, 바이엘은 수십 년의 연구에서 암과의 연관이 나오지 않았으므로 라운드업과 그 주성분 글리포세이트가 안전하다는 입장을 오래 유지해 왔어요. 바이엘의 빌 앤더슨 최고경영자는 최종 승인이 현재와 미래의 라운드업 소송 위험을 줄이려는 회사 전략에서 결정적인 이정표라고 말했어요.

paragraphs.en: Individual payments are expected to range from $10,000 to $165,000, depending on the type of exposure, the age at diagnosis and the subtype of lymphoma, MedicalDaily reported. Nine tiers set the starting values, with the top figure going to occupational claimants diagnosed before age 60 with an aggressive subtype and the lowest going to people diagnosed at 78 or older. Residential claimants who qualify for a quick-pay option could receive between $6,000 and $14,500, and final awards can be up to 20 percent above or below a tier's average. Occupational claimants generally need more than 80 hours of exposure in agricultural, industrial, turf or ornamental work, while people who already settled a Roundup claim are excluded.
paragraphs.ko: 메디컬데일리에 따르면 개인별 지급액은 노출 유형, 진단 나이, 림프종 종류에 따라 1만 달러에서 16만 5천 달러 사이가 될 전망이에요. 아홉 개 구간이 출발 금액을 정하는데, 가장 높은 금액은 60세 전에 공격적인 종류로 진단받은 직업 노출 청구자에게, 가장 낮은 금액은 78세 이상에 진단받은 사람에게 돌아가요. 빠른 지급 방식을 쓸 수 있는 가정용 노출 청구자는 6천 달러에서 1만 4천 500달러를 받을 수 있고, 최종 지급액은 구간 평균보다 최대 20퍼센트 높거나 낮을 수 있어요. 직업 노출 청구자는 대체로 농업, 산업, 잔디, 관상용 작업에서 80시간 넘게 노출돼야 하고, 이미 라운드업 청구를 합의한 사람은 제외돼요.

paragraphs.en: Objectors argued that payouts to individual cancer victims would be too low because claimants who settled earlier were paid more, but the judge overruled those objections. He said that delaying payments could force victims, including people whose cancer is terminal, to wait an indeterminate number of years to be paid. Dozens of people had objected, and lawyers for some of the Roundup victims who objected did not immediately respond to requests for comment after the ruling. Christopher Seeger, a lawyer for many of the plaintiffs, said the order delivers guaranteed compensation to victims who have waited more than a decade for justice.
paragraphs.ko: 반대자들은 앞서 합의한 청구자들이 더 많이 받았으므로 암 피해자 개인의 지급액이 너무 낮다고 주장했지만, 판사는 이 이의를 기각했어요. 그는 지급을 늦추면 말기 암 환자를 포함한 피해자들이 몇 년이 될지 모를 기간을 기다려야 할 수 있다고 말했어요. 수십 명이 이의를 냈고, 판결 직후 이의를 낸 일부 피해자의 변호사들은 논평 요청에 바로 답하지 않았어요. 많은 원고를 대리하는 크리스토퍼 시거 변호사는 이 명령이 10년 넘게 정의를 기다려 온 피해자들에게 보상을 보장해 준다고 말했어요.

paragraphs.en: The approval came after a bumpy path through the courts, beginning in March, when Judge Boyer granted preliminary approval and called the proposed payout significant. That step required Bayer to pay $500 million into a fund within 10 days to cover costs such as notifying class members, and it opened a window to object or opt out. Objecting plaintiffs then moved the class action to federal court on May 22, but in June U.S. District Judge Henry Edward Autrey sent it back, ruling that only a defendant has the right to transfer a case. The opt-out deadline passed on June 4, and the final approval hearing took place on Sept. 14.
paragraphs.ko: 승인은 법원에서 순탄하지 않은 길을 거쳐 나왔는데, 3월에 보이어 판사가 예비 승인을 하며 제안된 지급액이 상당하다고 말한 것이 시작이었어요. 그 단계에서 바이엘은 집단 구성원 통지 같은 비용을 대려고 열흘 안에 5억 달러를 기금에 넣어야 했고, 이의를 내거나 빠질 수 있는 기간도 열렸어요. 이후 이의를 낸 원고들이 5월 22일 집단소송을 연방 법원으로 옮겼지만, 6월에 헨리 에드워드 오트리 연방 판사는 사건을 옮길 권리가 피고에게만 있다며 되돌려 보냈어요. 빠져나갈 수 있는 기한은 6월 4일에 지났고, 최종 승인 심리는 9월 14일에 열렸어요.

paragraphs.en: The ruling also follows a June decision by the U.S. Supreme Court that overturned a $1.25 million jury award to a Missouri man, John Durnell, who blamed years of exposure to glyphosate for his non-Hodgkin lymphoma. In a 7-2 decision, the justices agreed with Bayer that a federal law regulating pesticides bars failure-to-warn claims brought under state law, undercutting a central pillar of many lawsuits. Seeger said that decision narrowed the ability of Roundup victims to pursue claims in court, which helps explain why the settlement route mattered to plaintiffs.
paragraphs.ko: 이번 판결은 존 더넬이라는 미주리주 남성이 글리포세이트에 여러 해 노출돼 비호지킨 림프종에 걸렸다며 받은 125만 달러 배심 평결을 뒤집은 6월 미국 연방대법원 결정 뒤에 나왔어요. 대법관들은 7대 2로, 농약을 규제하는 연방법이 주법에 따른 경고 의무 위반 청구를 막는다는 바이엘의 주장에 동의했고, 이는 많은 소송의 핵심 기둥을 약하게 만들었어요. 시거는 그 결정이 라운드업 피해자가 법정에서 청구를 이어 갈 길을 좁혔다고 말했고, 이는 원고들에게 합의가 왜 중요했는지 설명해 줘요.

sents.en: The ruling also follows a June decision by the U.S. Supreme Court that overturned a $1.25 million jury award to a Missouri man, John Durnell, who blamed years of exposure to glyphosate for his non-Hodgkin lymphoma.
sents.ko: 이번 판결은 존 더넬이라는 미주리주 남성이 글리포세이트에 여러 해 노출돼 비호지킨 림프종에 걸렸다며 받은 125만 달러 배심 평결을 뒤집은 6월 미국 연방대법원 결정 뒤에 나왔어요.

sents.en: In a 7-2 decision, the justices agreed with Bayer that a federal law regulating pesticides bars failure-to-warn claims brought under state law, undercutting a central pillar of many lawsuits.
sents.ko: 대법관들은 7대 2로, 농약을 규제하는 연방법이 주법에 따른 경고 의무 위반 청구를 막는다는 바이엘의 주장에 동의했고, 이는 많은 소송의 핵심 기둥을 약하게 만들었어요.

sents.en: Seeger said that decision narrowed the ability of Roundup victims to pursue claims in court, which helps explain why the settlement route mattered to plaintiffs.
sents.ko: 시거는 그 결정이 라운드업 피해자가 법정에서 청구를 이어 갈 길을 좁혔다고 말했고, 이는 원고들에게 합의가 왜 중요했는지 설명해 줘요.

paragraphs.en: Bayer bought Monsanto, the maker of Roundup, in 2018 for $63 billion, and its share price has since fallen 46 percent, according to the Guardian. The company settled much of the Roundup litigation for $10.9 billion in 2020 but was unable to win court approval of a $1.25 billion deal to resolve future claims. NPR noted that the new deal comes on top of that earlier one, under which Bayer agreed to pay roughly $10 billion to $11 billion over more than 100,000 claims.
paragraphs.ko: 가디언에 따르면 바이엘은 2018년 라운드업 제조사 몬산토를 630억 달러에 사들였고, 그 뒤 주가가 46퍼센트 떨어졌어요. 회사는 2020년 라운드업 소송의 상당 부분을 109억 달러에 합의했지만, 미래 청구를 정리하려던 12억 5천만 달러 합의는 법원 승인을 받지 못했어요. NPR는 새 합의가 10만 건이 넘는 청구에 대해 바이엘이 약 100억에서 110억 달러를 내기로 한 앞선 합의에 더해진 것이라고 짚었어요.

sents.en: Bayer bought Monsanto, the maker of Roundup, in 2018 for $63 billion, and its share price has since fallen 46 percent, according to the Guardian.
sents.ko: 가디언에 따르면 바이엘은 2018년 라운드업 제조사 몬산토를 630억 달러에 사들였고, 그 뒤 주가가 46퍼센트 떨어졌어요.

paragraphs.en: The science remains disputed, and the settlement is not a scientific finding about whether glyphosate causes cancer. The World Health Organization's cancer research agency classified glyphosate as probably carcinogenic to humans in 2015, while the Environmental Protection Agency has said it did not identify risks of concern, including for cancer. The agency is reviewing newer research, and MedicalDaily said an updated assessment is expected in early 2027, while large farmer studies such as the Agricultural Health Study have not found a clear link. NPR added that the issue has energized supporters of Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., even as the Trump administration sided with Bayer at the Supreme Court.
paragraphs.ko: 과학적 판단은 여전히 갈리고, 이 합의는 글리포세이트가 암을 일으키는지에 대한 과학적 결론이 아니에요. 세계보건기구 산하 암 연구 기관은 2015년 글리포세이트를 인체 발암 가능성이 높은 물질로 분류했지만, 미국 환경보호청은 암을 포함해 우려할 만한 위험을 찾지 못했다고 밝혔어요. 환경보호청은 새 연구를 검토 중이고, 메디컬데일리는 갱신된 평가가 2027년 초에 나올 예정이며 농업 건강 연구 같은 대규모 농민 연구는 뚜렷한 연관을 찾지 못했다고 전했어요. NPR는 이 문제가 로버트 F. 케네디 주니어 보건장관 지지자들에게 큰 쟁점이지만 트럼프 행정부는 대법원에서 바이엘 편을 들었다고 덧붙였어요.

sents.ko: 과학적 판단은 여전히 갈리고, 이 합의는 글리포세이트가 암을 일으키는지에 대한 과학적 결론이 아니에요.

sents.ko: NPR는 이 문제가 로버트 F. 케네디 주니어 보건장관 지지자들에게 큰 쟁점이지만 트럼프 행정부는 대법원에서 바이엘 편을 들었다고 덧붙였어요.

paragraphs.en: The approval does not mean money arrives right away, because the order can be appealed and an appeal would pause most payments until it is resolved. Claimants in urgent circumstances, such as those who are terminally ill or at risk of losing their housing, can still be paid even if an appeal is filed. The settlement also leaves out some lawsuits still pending in federal court, and Bayer has said about 200 of those cases remain, with the Supreme Court ruling giving it strong defenses. Claims are handled through the official settlement website, and claimants are warned to be cautious about anyone demanding upfront fees.
paragraphs.ko: 명령에 항소할 수 있고 항소가 걸리면 대부분의 지급이 해결될 때까지 멈추기 때문에, 승인이 곧 바로 돈이 들어온다는 뜻은 아니에요. 말기 질환자나 집을 잃을 위험에 놓인 사람처럼 급한 사정의 청구자는 항소가 제기돼도 지급받을 수 있어요. 합의는 연방 법원에 계류 중인 일부 소송을 제외하는데, 바이엘은 그런 사건이 약 200건 남아 있고 대법원 판결이 강한 방어 논리가 된다고 말했어요. 청구는 공식 합의 웹사이트를 통해 처리되며, 선불 수수료를 요구하는 사람은 조심하라는 안내가 있어요.

views.view: The judge found the deal fair and said delay could leave dying victims waiting years; Bayer calls it a decisive milestone.
Bayer denies a cancer link, yet scientists and the WHO's cancer agency have raised concerns about glyphosate; the Trump administration backed Bayer.
The ruling sets a path to compensation but not an immediate payout, and the settlement is not a scientific finding on glyphosate.

heads.title: Judge approves $7.25bn Bayer payout to settle claims that Roundup causes cancer
Judge Approves $7 Billion Settlement Over Claims That Roundup Caused Cancer
Bayer agrees to pay Roundup claims in settlement that could cost billions

why: It is one of the largest mass tort class settlements in U.S. history and may end Bayer's biggest legal overhang.
lines.agree: Both sides agree the settlement carries no admission of liability and that payments depend on exposure, age and lymphoma type.
lines.split: Objectors say payouts are too low, while the judge and Bayer say delay would hurt seriously ill victims.
lines.life: Students may meet the case in business, law or environment classes as a test of how companies manage product-safety risk.
lines.next: Watch whether objectors appeal, which would pause most payments, and the EPA's updated glyphosate assessment due in early 2027.

keyNumber.caption: 최대 21년에 걸쳐 나눠 낼 합의 총액이에요

quiz.q: How many claims had Bayer faced in American courts over Roundup?
quiz.qKo: 바이엘은 미국 법원에서 라운드업과 관련해 몇 건의 청구를 받았나요?
quiz.why: 2문단: “Bayer had faced roughly 65,000 claims in American state and federal courts”

quiz.q: Over how many years will Monsanto make its declining annual payments?
quiz.qKo: 몬산토는 줄어드는 연간 지급을 몇 년 동안 하나요?
quiz.why: 3문단: “declining, capped annual payments for up to 21 years”

quiz.q: Why did the judge overrule the objections to the settlement?
quiz.qKo: 판사는 왜 합의에 대한 이의를 기각했나요?
choices: The objectors missed the filing deadline
Bayer admitted that Roundup causes cancer
Delay could leave terminally ill victims waiting for years
quiz.why: 5문단: “delaying payments could force victims, including people whose cancer is terminal, to wait an indeterminate number of years to be paid”

issues.job: 기업이 제품 안전 소송 위험을 어떻게 관리하는지 = 「리스크 관리 · 기업 책임」 질문에 쓸 수 있어요.

talk.q: What can companies learn from Bayer's long Roundup legal fight?
talk.qKo: 바이엘의 긴 라운드업 소송에서 기업은 무엇을 배울 수 있을까요?
talk.answer: Bayer paid billions while still denying that Roundup causes cancer, which shows that legal risk can hurt a company for years. I think firms should take product-safety questions seriously early, because delay can be costly for everyone involved.
talk.answerKo: 바이엘은 라운드업이 암을 일으킨다는 점을 부인하면서도 수십억 달러를 냈고, 이는 법적 위험이 회사를 여러 해 괴롭힐 수 있음을 보여 줘요. 저는 기업이 제품 안전 문제를 일찍 진지하게 다뤄야 한다고 생각해요. 늦어지면 모두에게 비용이 크기 때문이에요.

issues.title: Modi Says AI Cannot Take Away Livelihoods of Skilled Workers, Urges Parity Between ITI and IIT Graduates
issues.titleKo: 모디 총리가 AI는 기술을 가진 노동자의 생계를 빼앗을 수 없다고 말하며 ITI와 IIT 졸업생을 똑같이 존중하자고 촉구해요
issues.gist: Prime Minister Narendra Modi told a skill convocation in Lucknow that AI cannot take away the livelihood of anyone with skills, predicting that skilled workers will be valued above paper-certificate holders. He also announced that India will host the WorldSkills Competition in Greater Noida in 2027.
issues.gistKo: 나렌드라 모디 총리는 러크나우 기술 학위 수여식에서 AI가 기술을 가진 사람의 생계를 빼앗을 수 없으며 숙련 노동자가 증서만 든 사람보다 더 높이 평가받을 것이라고 말했어요. 또 2027년 그레이터노이다에서 월드스킬스 대회를 연다고 발표했어요.
issues.easyKo: 인도 총리가 AI가 퍼져도 기술이 있는 사람의 일자리는 지켜질 것이라고 말했어요. 직업학교(ITI) 학생도 명문 공대(IIT) 학생만큼 존중받아야 한다고도 했어요.

paragraphs.en: Prime Minister Narendra Modi said on Saturday, Nov. 21, that although there is much debate about artificial intelligence, nobody can take away the livelihood of a person who possesses skills. He was addressing the fifth National Skill Convocation Ceremony at the Indira Gandhi Pratishthan in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath and Union Minister of State for Skill Development and Entrepreneurship Jayant Chaudhary also attended the event. "Times are changing," Modi said, adding that skilled individuals will command greater respect than people who merely hold certificates.
paragraphs.ko: 나렌드라 모디 총리는 11월 21일 토요일, 인공지능을 둘러싼 논의가 많지만 기술을 가진 사람의 생계는 아무도 빼앗을 수 없다고 말했어요. 그는 우타르프라데시주 러크나우의 인디라 간디 프라티슈탄에서 열린 제5회 전국 기술 학위 수여식에서 연설했어요. 라지나트 싱 국방장관, 요기 아디티아나트 우타르프라데시 주총리, 자얀트 차우드리 기술개발·창업 담당 연방 국무장관도 행사에 참석했어요. 모디는 "시대가 변하고 있다"며 기술을 가진 사람이 단지 증서만 가진 사람보다 더 큰 존중을 받게 될 것이라고 덧붙였어요.

paragraphs.en: He predicted that demand for people with skills and talent would grow, and that they would be valued above those who go around with paper certificates, wearing suits and ties. Modi said India can progress in the 21st century only by respecting skilled workers, and he pointed to steps taken under the "Shramev Jayate" initiative and the creation of a separate Ministry of Skill Development. Urging a shift in how society views vocational education, he said students of Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) deserve the same respect as those at the Indian Institutes of Technology. "Be it IIT or ITI, for me, students are the treasure, strength and future of the country," he said. Even the biggest companies may have only two or three people carrying paper certificates, he said, but they need 200 to 300 ITI-trained people to provide strength and run the company.

paragraphs.en: Modi framed the emphasis on skills in historical terms, saying that when invaders came to India their first attack was on its skills, including by cutting off the thumbs of artisans. The British were more sophisticated, he said, with the politician Thomas Babington Macaulay imposing an education system that turned a skill-based tradition into one that produced clerks. Even after independence, he added, clerical jobs kept their prestige while skill development and traditional craftsmanship took a back seat. He praised India's heritage of crafts, citing Lucknow's chikankari work, fine muslin, Banarasi and Kanchipuram silk, Kashmiri pashmina, kalamkari, steel for swords and bronze sculptures. Recalling the COVID-19 pandemic, he said the exodus of workers from cities to villages had shown how essential skilled manpower is to everyday life.
paragraphs.ko: 모디는 기술 중시를 역사의 틀로 설명하며, 침략자들이 인도에 왔을 때 가장 먼저 공격한 것이 기술이었고 장인들의 엄지를 자르는 방식도 썼다고 말했어요. 영국은 더 교묘했다며, 정치인 토머스 배빙턴 매콜리가 기술 중심의 전통을 서기를 길러 내는 교육 제도로 바꿔 놓았다고 그는 말했어요. 독립 뒤에도 사무직이 위신을 유지한 반면 기술 개발과 전통 공예는 뒷전으로 밀렸다고 그는 덧붙였어요. 그는 러크나우의 치칸카리 공예, 고운 모슬린, 바나라시와 칸치푸람 비단, 카슈미르 파시미나, 칼람카리, 검에 쓰는 강철, 청동 조각 등 인도의 공예 유산을 칭찬했어요. 그는 코로나19 때 노동자들이 도시에서 마을로 떠난 일이 숙련 인력이 일상에 얼마나 필수인지 보여 줬다고 떠올렸어요.

paragraphs.en: Modi said nearly 5,000 new ITIs have been built in a decade and that enrolment in ITIs has risen by more than 5 lakh, with the number of girls up more than two and a half times. He noted that India once imported mobile phones, whereas today the country's daughters make them and phones made in India are exported across the globe. In Uttar Pradesh, he said, expanding infrastructure and industry are opening opportunities for young people, with large mobile manufacturing facilities coming up, a semiconductor facility being established and BrahMos missiles being produced. Modi announced that India will host a major skills competition, reported as the 2027 WorldSkills Competition, in Greater Noida next year, with lakhs of skilled people from India and abroad expected to take part.
paragraphs.ko: 모디는 10년간 새 ITI가 5천 곳 가까이 지어졌고 ITI 재학생이 5라크(50만) 넘게 늘었으며 여학생 수는 2.5배 넘게 늘었다고 말했어요. 그는 인도가 한때 휴대전화를 수입했지만 이제는 나라의 딸들이 만들고 인도산 휴대전화가 전 세계로 수출된다고 짚었어요. 그는 우타르프라데시에서 늘어나는 기반 시설과 산업이 청년들에게 기회를 열고 있으며, 대규모 휴대전화 생산 시설이 들어서고 반도체 시설이 세워지며 브라모스 미사일이 생산된다고 말했어요. 모디는 내년 그레이터노이다에서 2027 월드스킬스 대회로 보도된 대규모 기술 경연을 인도가 연다고 발표했고, 국내외 수십만 명의 숙련 인력이 참가할 것이라고 했어요.

paragraphs.en: Separately, Modi sought to link the recent fall in gold prices to his appeal a year ago that citizens not buy gold unless they needed it. He said an ordinary person like him had asked and people bought less gold, which he said had helped them save money, and he compared this with how people once followed Lal Bahadur Shastri's request to skip one meal. Modi also said his government had handled the West Asia crisis and ensured there was no shortage of fuel and cooking gas in the country, according to Deccan Herald. He praised the Yogi Adityanath government for creating a safe environment for women, recalling that a woman at a factory inauguration in Varanasi had told him she could return home safely even after working until 11 pm. Closing his speech, Modi told young people that the entire sky is open before them, urging them to dream big and develop their skills.
paragraphs.ko: 이와 별개로 모디는 최근 금값 하락을 1년 전 필요하지 않으면 금을 사지 말라고 한 자신의 호소와 연결지으려 했어요. 그는 자신 같은 평범한 사람이 부탁하자 사람들이 금을 덜 샀고 덕분에 돈을 아꼈다고 말하며, 예전에 사람들이 랄 바하두르 샤스트리의 한 끼 거르기 요청을 따른 일에 견줬어요. 데칸 헤럴드에 따르면 모디는 정부가 서아시아 위기를 잘 다뤄 나라에 연료와 취사용 가스 부족이 없도록 했다고도 말했어요. 그는 바라나시의 공장 준공식에서 한 여성이 밤 11시까지 일해도 안전하게 귀가할 수 있다고 말했다며, 여성에게 안전한 환경을 만든 요기 아디티아나트 정부를 칭찬했어요. 연설을 마치며 모디는 청년들에게 하늘 전체가 눈앞에 열려 있다며 크게 꿈꾸고 기술을 키우라고 당부했어요.

views.view: Modi said skilled people will command greater respect than certificate holders and that India is moving towards becoming the world's skill capital.
The report lays out Modi's argument that skills have long defined India and that ITI graduates deserve the same respect as IIT students.
The report relays Modi's remark that there is much AI discussion but that no one can take away the livelihood of a skilled person.

heads.title: PM Modi links gold price dip to his appeal, says AI cannot take away jobs of skilled workers
'AI cannot take jobs of skilled workers,' says PM Narendra Modi
AI cannot take jobs of skilled workers, says Prime Minister Modi

why: Modi's speech frames skills and vocational training as India's answer to worries that AI will erase jobs.
It also signals more state attention to ITIs and to skills competitions.
lines.agree: Every account has Modi saying that, amid the AI debate, nobody can take away the livelihood of a person who possesses skills.
lines.split: The remarks are a political leader's reassurance, not an analysis, and the reports do not weigh them against evidence on AI and employment.
lines.life: For students, the message is that practical, demonstrable skills are being promoted alongside degrees, though the speech cites no new data on AI and jobs.
lines.next: Watch for details of the 2027 WorldSkills Competition in Greater Noida and for how ITI expansion continues.

talk.q: Do you think skills will matter more than certificates in the age of AI?
talk.qKo: AI 시대에는 증서보다 기술이 더 중요해질 것이라고 생각하나요?
talk.answer: Modi said skilled individuals will command greater respect than people who merely hold certificates. I think practical skills do help, but a certificate can still open the door to a first job. Maybe the best path is to combine both.
talk.answerKo: 모디는 기술을 가진 사람이 증서만 가진 사람보다 더 큰 존중을 받을 것이라고 했어요. 실용적인 기술이 도움이 된다고 생각하지만 증서도 첫 일자리의 문을 열어 줄 수 있어요. 둘을 함께 갖추는 것이 가장 좋을지도 몰라요.
